name: inspect-receptacle
title: Inspect a receptacle
description: Look into a container, a cabinet, an appliance cavity or onto a support and report the objects inside or on it. A closed cabinet is opened for the look and closed again.
use_when: The contents of a container or cabinet must be seen (opens it if needed).

not_to_be_confused_with.search: inspect examines one given receptacle; search chooses where to look.

receptacle.description: Container, articulated cabinet/appliance or support to examine.

contents.description: Objects found inside/on the receptacle and visible.

applicability.summary: Requires base_near(place=$receptacle). Some bound nouns add preconditions (see Conditions that depend on the bound nouns).

preconditions.meaning: Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).

postconditions.meaning: The robot saw the target in its head camera during this episode (set by look, search, inspect, explore).

failure.on_failure: stop and report the measured pre/postconditions; nothing is retried.

arg_formats.entity_ref: any annotated object, support, articulated part or button

returns.success: true when every precondition held, the action ran and every postcondition holds
returns.error_code: on failure: INPUT_MISSING, INPUT_UNKNOWN, PRECONDITION_FAILED, NO_PATH, POLICY_FAILED, SUBSKILL_FAILED or POSTCONDITION_FAILED
returns.preconditions: each precondition as evaluated before moving, with holds = true/false
returns.postconditions: each postcondition as evaluated after the action, with holds = true/false
returns.outputs: the measured values listed under Outputs
